notes.title: Position Filled: Publisher 📋
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that I’ve partnered with UK-based publisher Kwalee on Shift At Midnight!  



I want to reassure you guys that this will not affect the vision or direction of Shift at Midnight. I'm still making the game I've set out to make. Kwalee will just be assisting me with things like marketing, project management, QA testing, etc. so I can focus my attention on development!


Shift At Midnight is an online co-op horror game. You and up to 2 friends work the graveyard shift at a rural 90s gas station, though some of your customers aren't human.


Figure out if your customers are doppelgangers. Examine their ID, cross-check their details in the computer, and observe their behavior. One slip-up might expose a creature… or cost you your life.


If a creature manages to leave the store, all hell breaks loose. Barricade the doors, place traps, and find a place to hide. Survival is no longer guaranteed.


    [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3722330/Shift_At_Midnight"][/dynamiclink]
We will be making socials soon so keep your eyes peeled here!
